**Analysis.** Because the first link of the chain is psychological, the school can claim that disciplined work on attention, habit and motive is not merely palliative but causally interruptive, and this is exactly why it prescribes a preparatory therapy of conduct before any advanced contemplative technique. **Technical definition.** The levels of the mind-field (**citta-bhūmi**) are the five operative conditions of the mind-complex, classified by the dominance of the constituent qualities: scattered (**kṣipta**, active quality dominant), dull (**mūḍha**, inert quality dominant), distracted (**vikṣipta**, mixed with occasional lucidity), one-pointed (**ekāgra**, lucid quality dominant) and restrained (**niruddha**, all modifications arrested).
